name: Otome
source:
An old murder case resurfaces, transforming the school, once a place of learning and respect into a prison. Now trapped in a loop, Tomoe must solve the case to regain her freedom.

[Translated from [url=https://luizvt2702.itch.io/otome]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一桩陈年凶杀案再度浮出水面，将这座昔日充满求知与敬意的校园化作了一座牢笼。如今被困在时间循环之中的巴，必须解开案件真相，方能重获自由。

[译自[url=https://luizvt2702.itch.io/otome]itch.io[/url]]
